final_decision.rationale: 确定性 blur 步: blur_gaussian:4 在 pair0 PSNR=39.29dB/CI 10/10, signal 模式 spectral_slope + wiener_kernel MATCH (5/5 pairs), sev 3/5 与 lens:4/motion:4 均更差; JPEG(block_boundary 0.998<1.1, 叠加后 35.95dB + block 边界失配 102%)、contrast scale(26.23)/stretch(16.84)、brightness(mean_shift -1.7)、quantization(unique_G=223) 全部排除. 剥离 blur 后残差 std=2.5 且平滑/通道均匀, 与 'noise_gaussian_RGB(blur 前)+blur_gaussian:4' 仿真统计一致 (cross_ch 0.274 vs 0.279, rgb_ratio 1.06 vs 1.05); 说明存在 blur 前的加性 RGB 噪声. 因 noise→blur 顺序下噪声类型不可完全判别 (SKILL 54.7%) 且幅度介于 sev2/3, 噪声步标 UNCERTAIN; overall=UNCERTAIN.

R2: blur:5 单独 PSNR=34.66 已高, 剩余残差应来自全局 contrast (variance_ratio=0.651, mean_shift~0); 实测方差比大于 sev1 理论 0.5625, 说明真实 contrast 更弱或部分方差降低来自 blur, 先加最轻 sev1

R5: 跨子类型对比, gaussian:4=39.29dB 尚未 >40; MTF 已知不可区分 gaussian/lens, 测试 lens:4 (disk radius=6) 作为跨族替代
R6: gaussian:4=39.29dB 残差 RMSE~2.8; variance_ratio=0.651 需解释, scale 型 contrast 已被排除 (26.23dB), 测试非线性 stretch:1 (最轻, 理论上 var ratio~0.8, 与 blur 后残差方差降低相容)

P1 复核: 在 support pair1 上复核最终候选 blur_gaussian:4 (pair0 39.29dB)

R11: 噪声-模糊耦合假设. 剥离 blur:4 后残差平滑 (spatial_corr=0.99, 邻域相关), std=2.5, 通道均匀 (R2.4/G2.6/B2.5) → 疑似 blur 前已施加 RGB 高斯噪声 (blur sigma4 衰减因子~0.07 → sigma_white~35 ≈ sev3=38.25). 用 signal 模式检查 wavelet sigma 是否匹配 (seed 无关)

reflection_R1.trigger: R0 verdict=UNCERTAIN (noise step unclassifiable under noise->blur; R0 support PSNR 26.11 dB)
reflection_R1.protocol: signal reinterpretation (not residual diagnosis); 3 rounds; <=5 candidates; <=15 test_candidate calls; no GT access

signal_reinterpretation.r1_reinterpretation: blur_gaussian:4,contrast_weaken_scale:1 = 27.25 dB (vs 39.29 blur-only). contrast_weaken_scale sev1 = factor 0.75, i.e. residual RMSE ~11 => any available contrast severity is far too strong. variance_ratio 0.65 is explained by strong blur (gm_ratio=0.2236), not by a global step.
signal_reinterpretation.consequence: contrast definitively excluded; no global step

signal_reinterpretation.r1_reinterpretation: confirmed against x_distortion severity tables: brightness sev1 shift=0.10*255=25.5 levels (8 variants incl. gamma) >> 1.7; saturate_weaken sev1=0.70 HSV / 0.60 YCrCb vs observed 0.9387; quantization_median/hist give <=20/24 levels per channel vs unique_G 223.

signal_reinterpretation.r1_reinterpretation: compression_jpeg sev1 = quality 25 (strongest available quality); adding it to blur:4 lowers PSNR (35.95) => target contains no JPEG step. unique_G far above quantization levels.

signal_reinterpretation.r1_reinterpretation: peeled rgb_ratio pair0=1.06, pair1=1.14, both below the YCrCb signature range 1.35 (sev1) - 1.57 (sev3); ch_stds uniform (R2.4/G2.6/B2.5 and R4.3/G4.1/B4.6). RGB-family retained, YCrCb rejected.

signal_reinterpretation.signal: peeled residual after blur:4 across 5 pairs (RMSE 2.77/5.01/1.29/2.20/2.49); pair0 cross_ch=0.27 vs pair1 cross_ch=0.86
signal_reinterpretation.r0_interpretation: single noise_gaussian_RGB:3 (sigma_white~31) before blur, residual std ~2.5-3.1 constant
signal_reinterpretation.r1_reinterpretation: a fixed-sigma white noise after blur:4 yields a content-independent residual RMSE (sigma*||h||2); observed per-pair spread 1.29-5.01 (4x) is impossible for one fixed severity (pair2 < sev1 level; pair1 > sev3 level). The residual also changes character across pairs: channel-independent on pair0 (cross_ch 0.27) but image-structured on pair1 (cross_ch 0.86, ivc 0.95, vm_slope 0.0156). => the noise step is real but its type/severity are not identifiable under noise->blur (SKILL: 54.7% ~ random).
signal_reinterpretation.consequence: noise step stays UNCERTAIN; R0 sev3 kept, sev2 alternative kept

signal_reinterpretation.r1_reinterpretation: metric definition (residual = target - simulated in float) makes ~50% of pixels res<=0 by construction; extreme_pct is structurally inflated. Not impulse evidence.

candidate_ranking.verdict: best deterministic explanation; not sufficient for CHANGE (2/5 pairs <40 dB, residual unmodeled)

candidate_ranking.validation: verify_signals PARTIAL on 5/5 pairs (matched blur:spectral_slope, blur:wiener_kernel, noise:sigma; mismatch noise:structured_residual)
candidate_ranking.verdict: kept (noise step real but type/severity unresolved)

candidate_ranking.validation: pair1 PARTIAL (same matched set as RGB:3; structured_residual FWHM=18px)
candidate_ranking.verdict: no improvement; content-dependent residual hypothesis not confirmed

reflection_R1.noise_type_discrimination: All tested noise candidates (RGB:2, RGB:3, speckle:1, speckle:3) return PARTIAL with the identical matched set (blur:spectral_slope, blur:wiener_kernel, noise:sigma) and the same mismatched seed-dependent structured_residual. SKILL 54.7% under noise-before-blur => no majority WEAK->PARTIAL/MATCH improvement is achievable; protocol forbids a noise-step change on PSNR.

final_decision.rationale: blur_gaussian:4 solid (best in every pair, all alternatives worse); contrast/JPEG/global/quantization excluded by measurement and severity tables; noise step real (peeled residual std 2.5-4.4, channel-uniform, smooth) but type/severity unidentifiable under noise->blur. Deterministic simplification blur:4 reaches mean 40.17 dB but pooled 38.5 dB with 2/5 pairs <40 (pair1 34.13) and leaves a real residual; dropping noise on PSNR alone violates SKILL noise rules. Keep R0 pipeline at UNCERTAIN.
